# Prefill scratch lifetime alias implementation v1

2026-10-13. SOURCE_ONLY_UNVERIFIED. Main's COPY1 quiet measurement was left running.
Worktree: /home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/feat-prefill-scratch-lifetime-alias-20261013
Branch: feat/prefill-scratch-lifetime-alias-20261013
Exact base: 410904c99d273435b5302fa8976cc667d17957f2
Uncommitted source and Japanese-first/English documentation changes only. No tests,
build/import/AST/lint/GPU/profiler/process/service/reset/cleanup/commit/push performed.
git-workflow skill read; explicit task prohibitions override its commit/push rule.
Read R143/R312/R348/R350/R356/R357, source and targeted registry entries in
WF bench/results/2026-10-13-upstream-benchsh-quiet-copy0/report-registry-v184.json.
No historical reports, receipts, registry, main/root, WC/WF/phase worktree edited.

Implemented files: src/prefill/prefill.cpp, docs/XE.ja.md, docs/XE.md.
Exact STRATA_PREFILL_SCRATCH_ALIAS=1 is process-frozen at first reference, default OFF.
Values unset, empty, 0, 01, 1x, 2, -1 or whitespace are OFF. Both aliases share this
predicate in bytes_needed, gdn_set_bytes and actual carve, including borrowed relayout.
Init rejects an out-of-order compute queue before allocation. No new polling,
barrier removal or stream/event completion change. Runtime compute queue property
and Gemm::init_external stream binding are existing contracts.

LIFETIME / OWNERSHIP
emb/bo/ple_emb now point to one T*N FP32 allocation. Both skipped takes really
are skipped: owned does not contain three copies of that pointer. release still
drains compute/copy before freeing owned; borrowed pointers never enter owned.
All branches of gr_write/gr_write_norm_rs/gr_write_cvec_norm_rs consume bo on m.cs.
emb's last reader is gr_broadcast before the layer loop. Native batched gather,
quantized batched gather, per-token embedding and vision row upload all publish
emb on m.cs before that broadcast. With hand_in the residual is uploaded directly
to R and emb has no reader. Layer 0's attention/MoE output and write finish before
the layer-1 ple_land upload on that same queue. Batched PLE reads every subbatch
before layer-1 half 0; per-token PLE also finishes all reads/history advances first.
No other m.ple_emb reader exists. PLE OFF has no upload or reads. Layer splits:
LB=0/LE=1 lands PLE after the final bo reader; LB=1 lands PLE before its block;
LB>1 may land rows but never reads them, before its bo writes. Handoff consumes
R, not the aliased plane, and its existing completion waits are retained.
BF16x2 low parts, MMQ versus FP16 fallback, CPU experts and control-vector writes
use their existing independent inputs; all bo producers still precede the same
gr_write last-reader boundary. Default/compact MoE eligibility is unchanged.

qkv/y: static_assert C>=ZV proves extent for every positive T, including short
chunks. qkv T*C is projected then consumed by gdn_conv on m.cs; convolution
serial/short/tiled/fused/non-fused variants finish their qkv reads before recurrence.
y remains FP32, now at qkv's base; no kernel signature/write/math is removed.
Serial recurrence writes y and y_h; lane/D2/key-head writes raw y then the common
normalizer reads y to produce y_h. The chooser's yy is independent; its waits and
temporary allocation remain. hbuf/z/gate/beta do not overlap qkv. Output projects
y_h. QSA scratch and MoE scratch are unmodified alternative layouts of the same
max region and run after/before complete half boundaries. draft_kv and batched
PLE already size subbatches from region_bytes: smaller maximum may change their
batch size, so parity/restore is still an explicit runtime gate.
No supported source combination needs a shape/route fallback beyond the existing
geometry validation and the new mandatory in-order check. This is a source proof,
not runtime qualification. No QSA Kc/Vc alias, dtype/precision, head/cache lease,
chunk auto-increase, quantization, CPU SIMD or context-bound changes are included.

REQUESTED BYTE ACCOUNTING
Alloc.take charges align256(payload+256). Remove two guarded T*N float takes
outside the region and one guarded T*ZV float take inside GDN. Formula for any
valid T: top saving=2*align256(4*T*N+256); local GDN saving=align256(4*T*ZV+256);
global region saving=max(G_before,Q,M)-max(G_after,Q,M), not local GDN saving.
Under R356/R357 current compact fallback, E=512, cap=2051, max_blocks=65538,
BF16x2 OFF, ring=16, fixed context=262144, mode1:
T8192: GDN 1180698624 -> 979371776; QSA 1120979712; MoE 1087671808;
winner QSA; region saving 59718912 B (56.952 MiB); top saving 167772672 B;
combined requested saving 227491584 B (216.952 MiB).
T16384: GDN 2361395200 -> 1958741760; QSA 2148682496; MoE 2175340032;
winner MoE; region saving 186055168 B (177.436 MiB); top saving 335544832 B;
combined requested saving 521600000 B (497.437 MiB).
8K->16K requested delta after both aliases 2161001216 B = 2060.891 MiB.
Owned ring coalescing versus borrowed per-slot guards remains the existing rule;
bytes_needed includes existing conservative 8 MiB slack. Local skip/count changes
are identical on each path. Lazy GEMM/library/JIT owners and first-use GDN chooser
yy (potential 192/384 MiB) are outside these counts. No physical-fit claim follows.

OBSERVABILITY
Existing STRATA_TRACE plus alias=1 emits one layout line after successful carve:
T, borrowed, actual Alloc.used requested total, GDN/QSA/MoE requested set bytes,
region maximum/winner and emb/bo/ple_emb/qkv/y addresses. This is per layout, not
per token/kernel; normal runs add no logging. Winner ties deterministically name
GDN then QSA. Actual Alloc.used is not physical allocation size or bytes_needed's
slack-inclusive conservative count. No extra diagnostic option was added.

MAIN CHECKS AFTER QUIET MEASUREMENT CLOSES
1. Review diff; build with source-built intel/llvm in free and contrib-llvm using
   the original Intel-only recipes (R348 build/runtime contract), no icpx, no new
   warnings. Run required host/SYCL checks in Main's serialized test/build window.
2. Separate fresh processes for unset/0/exact1/01/1x and frozen-setting behavior.
   With STRATA_TRACE verify the alias address equalities, selected max and requested
   counts for owned and borrowed 8K/16K plus smaller T, relayout shrinking/regrowing.
   Reject an out-of-order queue. Check ownership release and failure cleanup once.
3. Run the fixed-history full-logit/state comparator alias OFF vs ON with identical
   model, build, token IDs, history and offsets. Standard >=32049-token prompt,
   mode1, every chunk including tail; preserve official out24 policy. Compare
   residuals/logits, GDN recurrent/conv state, QSA KV codes/scales/indexer and PLE
   history, checkpoints/restored second continuation, callback positions/counts.
4. Cover GDN serial heads, lane eligible/ineligible, D2/keyhead and pipeline on/off;
   conv serial/short/tiled/norm branches; PLE batch/per-token/off; vision rows,
   layer splits before/at/after layer1 and hand_in; BF16x2 modes; MMQ/mixed fallback,
   compact enabled/disabled, CPU expert share, control vectors and draft_kv fallback.
   All numerical kernels are unchanged, but different PLE/draft batching needs
   measured parity. Existing compact/debug incompatibility remains rejected.
5. Measure pre-init/init/first-BF16/first-GDN/post-chooser peaks separately from
   requested bytes, in free and contrib-llvm. Admit fixed 16K only after measured
   fit with the existing reserve and full parity; never auto-select it from these
   counts. Then stock bench.sh --long --runs 3, actual input/output, alias OFF/ON,
   and source TPS independently. COPY1 baseline is still Main's active task.
6. Full262144 context cell-count/bounds/callback proof stays unchanged; no maximum
   fit or quality assertion is authorized. Follow artifact retention, preserving
   compact samples/fault evidence and only required current captures; this task
   performed no cleanup and created no traces/tensors.

No new tests were added: a source-mirroring layout test would not validate queue
lifetime or ownership. Actual production layout logging and Main's independent
state/logit/ownership/relayout checks are the required evidence. All execution,
warnings, physical fit, speed and quality remain UNVERIFIED until those checks.
